data.name: Premier Forest
data.description: Premier Forest Products is a Newport (South Wales) based timber importer, sawmiller, and distributor operating multiple sites across the UK, with wholesale of wood and panel products as its core business. As an adjacent operation, it runs a biomass pyrolysis facility that converts its own wood waste into biochar bricks sold to compost producers, previously registered under the Puro.earth biochar methodology.
